purpose: Test whether the phase-consistency route's null miscalibration and the power route's behavior persist under schedule-density perturbation. Design note (verified in code): the phase-route event selector is the row-order local-maximum rule on z_e; plain midpoint insertion provably leaves the phase event set unchanged, so the 1.5x construction is midpoint interpolation plus deterministic peak-scrambling of every inserted row, which genuinely perturbs the phase event set, the ERP cross-fit event count, and the surrogate forbidden-domain construction. The power route is unaffected by event selection (support-gated only) and serves as the density-null contrast.

1p0x.relation: Paired reference pool for the density contrast = nullpool_edgeguard_20260829 (400 worlds, M02-replay configuration with base-contract guards 1.5/1.5/0.75; matched seed_index 1:120). The older nullpool (pre-edgeguard guard configuration) is NOT the paired reference; using it would confound density effects with guard-configuration differences. Reused without rerun or merging.

one_point_five.rule: Preserve all 1901 source rows. Exactly one midpoint row is inserted for each of 951 selected source-adjacent intervals (1-based interval i joins rows i and i+1; interval 1900, whose right endpoint is the single source-incomplete row, is ineligible). Rows emitted in temporal order.

inserted_row_rule.label_index: negative sequence number -1,-2,... in insertion order
inserted_row_rule.z_e: peak-scrambled: max(z_left, z_right) + eps, eps = 0.0499435396009228 (0.05 x frozen SD); plain midpoint is NOT used for z_e
inserted_row_rule.nine_delta_z: joint arithmetic midpoint of the two endpoints
inserted_row_rule.other_42_columns: arithmetic midpoint of the two endpoints, except source_complete set to 1 and movie_time columns recomputed from label_time_s per the frozen polynomial relations t-240.875 and t^2-481.75t+58020.765625; z-scored movie_time columns use endpoint midpoint (declared approximation, validator asserts membership in the endpoint z-closed interval)
inserted_row_rule.float_safety: verified: eps exceeds the minimum adjacent z_e difference (8.9e-6) by four orders, so the strict-peak condition holds unconditionally in double precision

interval_selection.strata: ten equal-width strata over the 1899 eligible intervals: 1-190, 191-380, ..., 1711-1899
interval_selection.selection: within-stratum Threefry permutation order, take first k

one_point_five.variance_statement: Inserted rows contract local variance for the nine delta_z columns; scrambled rows' z_e is raised by eps above the endpoint maximum. Declared properties of the densification operator; no re-standardization.

zero_point_five.rule: Retain source row 1. Form 950 adjacent pairs (2,3),(4,5),...,(1900,1901). Retain exactly one row per pair by Bernoulli(0.5) draws from the same Threefry stream (row 1901, the source-incomplete row, is selectable; downstream source_complete gating applies as usual). Output 951 rows in temporal order; first and last source rows are always retained.

schedule_transform.nan_boundary_rules: Source rows are never altered. Only adjacent complete-source rows may generate a midpoint. The parent schedule is a single continuous 0.25-s grid (verified: all 1900 adjacent gaps equal 0.25 s; no cuts). No extrapolation before the first or after the last event. A generated numeric value that is NaN/Inf is a hard failure.

crn_and_seeding.world_seed_formula: 20260827 + 100000 + seed_index (identical to the P0-1 historical null-pool formula)
crn_and_seeding.matched_seed_domain: seed_index 1:120 for every new arm; pairwise contrast against the M-REF pool nullpool_edgeguard_20260829 (M02 replay configuration, base-contract guards 1.5/1.5/0.75) at identical seed_index; new-arm subject inclusion follows the historical both-columns-finite rule (both Mpower and Mphase are computed for every pair in the Mphase arms)
crn_and_seeding.p0_4_relation: P0-4 seeds (91000000+100000*5+si) are a separate namespace and are not a reference pool
crn_and_seeding.bitwise_crn_claim: For null worlds, eta/polarity/phi/background 1/f are drawn outside the event loop and additive injection consumes no stream draws; with identical world seed the synthesized signals are bitwise identical across schedules, so schedule is the only difference within a seed pair. Verified in code review; asserted on a sample in smoke.

Mphase_0p5.config: M-REF = M02 replay path byte-for-byte (base contract surrogate 1.5/1.5/0.75 + acc01_compute_phase_metric_optimized + maxNumCompThreads(1))

Mpower_1p5.config: P-REF = acc01_compute_power_metric under the base contract
Mpower_1p5.verdict: none; descriptive paired delta only (plan 8.5: verdict belongs to the Mphase contrast)

corner_probe_G06.config: P0-2 powercurve Mpower path quoted verbatim (incl. sign_flip)
corner_probe_G06.comparison: descriptive contrast vs the P0-2 historical G06 cell (265 worlds); bitwise background identity vs historical G06 asserted on 3 sample seeds
corner_probe_G06.role: independent mechanism-consistent sensitivity check; never enters the primary verdict

verdict_rules.primary_contrast: Delta = FPR_1p5x - FPR_1p0x on matched seed indices, computed separately for R1 and R2; no cross-run pooling
verdict_rules.paired_unit: world-level binary rejection (two-sided exact sign-flip family p <= 0.05) per (seed_index, run)
verdict_rules.interval: Newcombe (1998b, Stat Med 17:2635-2650) paired-difference method 10, two-sided 95%. Closed form: with discordant counts b (new-only reject) and c (old-only reject), concordant counts e (both) and h (neither), n=e+b+c+h, d=(b-c)/n, p_b=(e+b)/n, p_c=(e+c)/n, phi=(e*h-b*c)/sqrt((e+b)(c+h)(e+c)(b+h)) (continuity-corrected numerator max(e*h-b*c-n/2,0) when e*h>b*c; phi=0 when the denominator vanishes), and (l_b,u_b),(l_c,u_c) the Wilson score bounds of p_b,p_c: CI = [d-sqrt((p_b-l_b)^2-2*phi*(p_b-l_b)*(u_c-p_c)+(u_c-p_c)^2), d+sqrt((u_b-p_b)^2-2*phi*(u_b-p_b)*(p_c-l_c)+(p_c-l_c)^2)]. ZCode provides an independent Python second implementation for cross-checking

classification.indeterminate: otherwise; fixed text: The density perturbation did not yield a decisive attenuation or persistence verdict under the preregistered precision rule.

verdict_rules.prohibition: The verdict is produced solely by the preregistered thresholds and frozen interval; no post hoc selection of any kind.
verdict_rules.descriptive_rows: paired_fpr_contrast.tsv additionally carries descriptive (verdict-free) paired rows for Mphase_0p5 vs 1x and Mpower_1p5 vs 1x, plus per-level Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals (plan 8.5); these never enter the primary verdict.

census_sensitivity.schedules: four census-only 1.5x schedules: two interval-permutation replicates (seeds base+600101, base+600102) and two eps variants (0.025*SD, 0.10*SD, same interval selection as the main schedule)
census_sensitivity.method: per-pair feasible-domain enumeration via acc01_build_empirical_surrogates following validate_acc00_simulation.m:feasibleCensus
census_sensitivity.exclusion: no census-sensitivity output enters FPR estimates, Newcombe intervals, or the verdict

outputs.prohibited: no new diagnostic-panel members, no exploratory verdict tables

execution.orchestration: serial arms, parfor over seed indices within an arm (P0-4 pattern)
execution.thread_policy: maxNumCompThreads(1) in every worker (M02 replay precedent)
execution.checkpoint_policy: atomic per-world checkpoint with arm, seed_index, world_seed, schedule sha256, thread evidence, MATLAB version, status
execution.resume_policy: resume only checkpoints whose identity fields all match this frozen contract

annex.identity_transform_discovery: Plain midpoint insertion leaves the phase event set bit-identical (proven analytically on the selector rule and verified numerically: 494 peaks at 1x, 494 at 1.5x with zero inserted-row peaks). This is why peak-scrambling is part of the frozen construction rather than an option.
